title: Souls
kicker: Stocks and economy · summon and fusion
loopLine: Summon and fusion · Level up and power
hook: **Souls** are the currency you earn by playing and spend to call new demons and keep them bound.

blindSpots.meaning: A **currency number** in your save. Not a demon, not a life bar, not something you lose on death.
Souls leave your bank the moment you confirm at the [altar](summoning-altar). There is no refund.
One shared pool for the whole save. It is not per demon and not per world.
Play pays. Waiting does not — there is no idle soul trickle.

alsoTrue: Souls are one of three stocks. The others are [essence](essence) and [loam](loam), and they do not convert into each other.

sections.title: What it is
paras: One bank, shown in the HUD wherever you are.
You watch it climb while you play and drop when you summon.
sections.note: Souls bank across worlds — see [New world](new-world-prestige).

cards.name: Faucets
cards.body: Lawn matches, expedition returns, and map work pay souls.

cards.name: Sinks
cards.body: Altar pulls and pact upkeep spend them.

rows: Souls on a win, scaled by what you fought

groups.title: In the HUD
groups.intro: The stock strip is always on screen.

doSteps: Play a lawn match to the end.
Spend once, and read what the pull cost.

mixUps.q: Do I lose souls when a demon dies?
mixUps.a: No. Souls are a bank, not a health pool.
No. There is no store — this build is local and has no payments.
No. Only [loam](loam) fades if you neglect ground.
